run_paraphrase_cli: run the paraphrase CLI tool with en2fr and fr2en model paths to generate paraphrases from input text
run_back_translation_paraphrasing: run back-translation paraphrasing by translating English to French then back to English using a mixture of experts model
run_gen_paraphrases: run the gen_paraphrases function to generate multiple paraphrases of an English sentence using N experts
run_transformer_translate: run the TransformerModel translate method to translate text between English and French using pretrained fairseq models
run_moe_expert_selection: run the fr2en MOE model with a specific expert index via inference_step_args to get varied paraphrase outputs
